chunks.text: We evaluate ResNet-Light on the ImageNet validation set. The proposed model achieves a top-1 accuracy of 78.5%, outperforming the prior CNN baseline on the same split. Training uses Adam with learning rate 0.001.
ResNet-Light is trained on ImageNet with batch size 256 and the Adam optimizer. The learning rate is fixed at 0.001 for all convolutional blocks.
Compared with ResNet-50 on ImageNet, ResNet-Light improves top-1 accuracy to 78.5% while keeping comparable FLOPs.
